title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. بتائیں کہ مجھے ” غلام “ یا ”محمد “ سے نام رکھنا چاہئے؟ 3608 views Q. My daughter name 2451 views Q. By the grace of Allah I am blessed with a son on 12th March -2010 at 12.50PM. Kindly suggest some sahabhi names with meaning for my son. and ask me details for aqiqah. 1769 views Q. مجھے صوفیہ (Sofia) ، شایان (Shayan) اور شنجل (Shanjal)، کے معنی بتائیں اورلڑکی کے کچھ اچھے نام بھی بتائیں۔ 3480 views Q. اصفا فاطمہ (Aasfa fathima) نام کے بارے میں بتائیں۔کیا یہ نام شریعت کی روشنی میں درست ہے؟براہ کرم، کوئی ایسا نام بتائیں جو بہت زیادہ اچھا ہو اور اس کے بہت سارے فضائل ہوں۔ میں اپنی بیٹی کا نام رکھنا چاہتاہوں جو کل پیدا ہوئی ہے۔ 1763 views Q. Babay name 1988 views Q. From a book by a respected Muhaddis (who studied in Darul Uloom Deoband, and currently teaching as Shaikh-ul-Hadith in Jamia Darul Ma'arif, Chittagong) in our country I came to know that if a person is named MUHAMMAD, then he may be awarded Jannat (Heaven) , just for being named MUHAMMAD. Is it true ? Please, kindly give me proper descriptions & evidences regarding this. If it is true, then will it also work in my case since my name consists of four parts and Muhammad is one of them, but I am called in short by Shawkat ? 2700 views Q. Assalmualaikum, I want the meaning of the names: (1) Basheer ahmad, a boy name & (2) Nida ,a girl name. Remember me in dua. 2181 views Q. ISLAMIC NAMES 3283 views Q. Please guide us about the name of girl i.e 'Zulaikha'. Is it permissible or not? 3523 views Q. Respected pious scholar,Is my name kaynat shamsi fine or should change my name? 1574 views Q. My name is Mohammad Irshad I have a question that what we should write. So Far I am using Mohammad or Mohd whereas if i translate as per Urdu it comes Muhammad. Is it ok to use Mohammad or Mohd or Md. 2677 views Q. My wife is expecting. She would be delivering in a few days. I have heard that if a person makes niyat that he would name the newborn as Muhammad, then he would be gifted with a son. I had decided in my mind that Insha Allah I would name my first born "Muhammad Imdadullah", with due to respect to the prophet SAS and love for the saint Haji Imdadullah Makki (RAH). But on consulting an aalim, he has said that the name is a mismatch. I'm in a predicament, whether I can add Haji sahab's name to the name Muhammad or not? Please guide me. 2801 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 61831 Country: India Title: opinion of name Question: We have named our daughter as Samrah at birth in azaan we were told its the name of sahaba and it also appears in the Quran. Please let us know your opinion for this name. Answer ID: 61831 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1222/1222/M=01/1437) Samrah is a Jewish sect who denies any prophet after Prophet Musa, may peace and blessings of God be upon him. والسامرى أحد السامرة وهم طائفة من اليهود ينكرون نبوة من جاء بعد موسى عليه السلام . (تبصيرالمنتبه بتحرير المشتبه لابن حجر العسقلانى ج 2 ص 712 ط: المكتبة العلمية بيروت، لبنان) The exact word of Samrah is not available in the holy Quran. We also did not find anywhere Samrah as the name of any sahabiyah. Hence it is better to select any other name for your daughter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
